title: Dodgers have a higher payroll than Brewers, Rays, and Guardians combined
seoTitle: Dodgers Payroll Exceeds Brewers, Rays & Guardians
subtitle: Salary comparison reveals disparity in resources in the MLB semifinals
excerpt: The Dodgers spend $339 million, an amount higher than the combined salaries of the Brewers, Rays, and Guardians, who still advance in the MLB series.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Los Angeles Dodgers reach the National League Championship Series (NLCS) with the highest payroll in the league, surpassing the combined total of the Milwaukee Brewers, Tampa Bay Rays, and Cleveland Guardians. This financial contrast draws attention as the four teams compete in the Major League Baseball semifinals.

Budget difference between Dodgers and opponents

According to the website Talkin' Baseball, the Dodgers' budget reaches $339 million. By comparison, the Milwaukee Brewers record just over $146 million, the Tampa Bay Rays $95.6 million, and the Cleveland Guardians $74.4 million. The sum of the latter three equals approximately $316 million, still lower than the Dodgers' spending.

Dodgers' spending strategy

In recent years, the franchise has signed extensive contracts with standout players, including Shohei Ohtani, Yoshinobu Yamamoto, and Kyle Tucker. This investment policy has yielded results, with the team winning two consecutive World Series and remaining in the NLCS for three straight seasons.

How lower-resource teams went far

Despite financial limitations, the Brewers, Rays, and Guardians advanced by eliminating teams with higher budgets in the division series. The Brewers defeated the San Diego Padres, who rank ninth in spending; the Rays defeated the New York Yankees, third in payroll; and the Guardians overcame the Chicago White Sox, 24th in expenses.

Performance of low-budget teams

The Brewers finished the regular season with the best record in MLB (103-59), securing home-field advantage in the NLCS against the Dodgers. Meanwhile, the ALCS will feature the matchup between the Rays and the Guardians, representing the lowest-spending teams in the American League.

Outlook for the remainder of the playoffs

The duel between the Dodgers and Brewers tests whether heavy investment guarantees the continuation of a potential three-peat. On the other hand, the trajectory of the Rays and Guardians demonstrates that different strategies, focused on efficiency and internal development, can also lead to success in the decisive phases of MLB.

With information from Bleacher Report.
